Bad Inmate - Release Date Announcement Trailer | PS VR Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019892

Bad Inmate is coming to PlayStation VR2 on December 10, 2026!

Get ready for a hilarious, physics-driven VR prison sandbox where breaking the rules is just the beginning! Sneak past guards, steal keys, prank inmates, and turn everyday objects into ridiculous escape tools.

Dig your way out with a spoon, uncover hidden secrets, and improvise your own chaotic escape plans. Every object is an opportunity, every decision can backfire, and no two escape attempts have to be the same.

Think you have what it takes to break free?
